equation: kPa = (a + b*R) / (1 - c*R - d*T), R in kOhm, T in degC

guards.refuse_when: resistance < 0, or denominator <= 0 (the pole), or kPa < 0

vectors.name: saturated_cold
vectors.description: Freshly watered, cold spring soil. Well inside the wet end where the sensor stops being quantitative.

vectors.name: wet_end_boundary
vectors.description: 9.75 cb — just under the 10 cb floor below which resolution collapses.

vectors.name: trigger_low_cool
vectors.description: 24.3 cb at dawn. The SAME resistance as trigger_low_warm — only soil temp moved.

vectors.name: trigger_low
vectors.description: 28.4 cb — dead centre of the 25-30 cb irrigation trigger.

vectors.name: trigger_low_warm
vectors.description: 34.2 cb in afternoon soil. Uncompensated this reads as 'irrigate' while trigger_low_cool reads 'hold off', on one unchanged sensor.

vectors.name: trigger_high
vectors.description: 33.0 cb — the dry edge of the trigger band.

vectors.name: stress_low
vectors.description: 54.7 cb — the middle of the 50-60 cb stress threshold.

vectors.name: stress_high
vectors.description: 60.5 cb — the top of the stress band. Past here the crop is paying for it.

vectors.name: stress_cold_soil
vectors.description: The same 10 kΩ in near-freezing soil reads lower — the compensation is signed.

vectors.name: very_dry
vectors.description: 121 cb. Well past any irrigation decision, still on the scale.

vectors.name: scale_ceiling
vectors.description: 238.9 cb — the last value under Irrometer's 239 cb ceiling.

vectors.name: above_scale_clamps
vectors.description: 278.6 cb computed, clamped to 239. Reported as 'at least this dry'.

vectors.name: near_pole_clamps
vectors.description: ~26,300 cb computed — the denominator is still positive, so the pole guard passes it. The clamp is what makes this region safe.

vectors.name: dead_short
vectors.description: 5.39 cb. Zero ohms is a legal reading — a shorted block — not an error.

vectors.name: pole_at_twenty_c
vectors.description: Denominator -0.000174. The pole sits at 77.98 kΩ when T=20.

vectors.name: pole_moves_warm
vectors.description: Fine at 0 °C, past the pole at 30 °C: the pole moves from 102.7 kΩ to 65.6 kΩ across the soil-temperature range. A fixed resistance ceiling cannot guard it.

vectors.name: in_domain_when_cold
vectors.description: The positive control for pole_moves_warm — same resistance, cold soil, valid.

vectors.name: negative_resistance
vectors.description: Not a resistance at all. Distinct from the legal zero above.
